candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record strongly supports cryptococcal meningitis with a positive serum cryptococcal antigen test (1:320) in an HIV-positive patient with a very low CD4 count (6 cells/mm^3) and neurological symptoms. The brain CT findings of multiple enhancing nodular white matter lesions are also consistent with CNS cryptococcosis.
